prompt:
Subject: An appraiser examining an object a second time.

Composition: Show an appraiser examining an antique vase again through a magnifying glass at a valuation desk. A crossed-out earlier price of 100 and a freshly written 150 appear on the same appraisal sheet, making the revised assessment explicit.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only the crossed-out 100 and replacement 150 on the appraisal sheet. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: The vase's reassessment replaces its earlier value of 100 with a new value of 150.
ja: 花瓶の再評価で、以前の100という評価額を150に改めています。
